sections.text:
When we turn raise-lower switch 
 to raise check that raise light goes on and set point increase to MAX. 
 measured the voltage by connect voltammeter at point (1G) and (10H) at 
 calibrator set { pin (39 ) of card SSLB }. It must be (-7 volt) if it 
 is not adjust it must be adjust from R(124){4} at card SSLB (1L1U).

When we turn raise-lower switch 
 to lower check that lower light goes on and set point decrease to Min. 
 measured the voltage by connect voltammeter at point (1G) and (10H) at 
 calibrator set. It must be (5 volt) if it is not adjust it must be adjust from 
 R(125){3} at card SSLB (1L1U).
